text:
mina: dropping a quick UX review for the routing policies editor. Focus: reorder affordances, shadowed rule messaging, and the preview "step" UX. Screenshot: https://img.example/editor-reorder.png

raaj: first pass looks solid. main ask: keyboard reorder. relying on drag handles only will fail accessibility tests. propose: focus a rule row, then use Alt+ArrowUp/ArrowDown to move. show a small live hint when focused.

lotte: +1. also think numeric sequencing will help when lists get long. show a compact badge (1,2,3). maybe allow renumbering?

chris: on shadowed rules, testers thought ghosting made rules disappear. Instead of low-opacity, show a persistent yellow banner: "Shadowed by Rule 2 (superset)" and include quick actions: [Edit] [Move earlier].

mina: love the action buttons. For copy, avoid jargon for non-technical users. Suggested phrasing: "This rule will never run because a previous rule matches all of its conditions. Try reordering or editing."

raaj: that's clearer. Small microcopy tweak: end with a single-sentence suggestion not two fragments. Maybe: "Try moving it earlier or narrowing its conditions."

lotte: preview step-through: current prototype animates requests through the list. request to add a dropdown for sample profile (cold-start, long-prompt, few-token). Also add a per-request compact trace: [req id] • matched: Rule 4 • model: small • cache: hit. Collapse by default.

chris: telemetry note: capture when users accept the suggested fix from the banner (edit vs move). We'll need an event for `shadowed_rule_resolved`.

mina: visual contrast: priority badges use thin gray text now. Use bold white on colored pill, ensure 4.5:1 contrast. Also avoid only-color meaning in badges; include position numbers.

raaj: keyboard hint: when focused, show inline label "Press Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ to move" and make that label readable by screenreaders (aria-live polite).

lotte: copy for move buttons: testers found "Move earlier" / "Move later" clearer than up/down. let's adopt that. Also prefer icon + label for smaller viewports.

ux-bot: accessibility check run: focus order OK for rows, need to ensure drag handle is focusable, tooltip has role=tooltip and aria-describedby pointing to the banner.

mina: decisions: 1) Add Alt+Arrow keyboard reorder + visible hint, 2) Keep numeric badges bold on colored pill, 3) Replace ghosting with shadow banner + [Edit]/[Move earlier], 4) Preview: add sample set dropdown + collapsed per-request trace, 5) Track `shadowed_rule_resolved` telemetry. Lotte to update mocks, Raaj to prototype keyboard, Chris to spec telemetry.

lotte: I'll update Figma and post a short GIF by EOD: https://figma.example/reorder-shadow-v2

raaj: prototyping keyboard now, will share video here.

chris: writing the telemetry spec and sending lightweight event map shortly.

mina: thanks team 680 we'll revisit after PRs land. Closing thread for now.
